sections.title: Why rules
sections.body: Lexicove is a place to learn together. These rules apply to the chat, direct messages, usernames and names.

sections.title: Respect others
sections.body: No insults, harassment, threats or hate speech of any kind. Mistakes in English are fine: correct others kindly.

sections.title: No spam or scams
sections.body: No ads, flooding, repeated messages or suspicious links. New accounts can’t post links for their first day.

sections.title: Safe content
sections.body: No adult, violent or illegal content. The community is for people aged 13 and over.

sections.title: Privacy
sections.body: Don’t post personal data such as phone numbers, addresses, passwords or documents, yours or anyone else’s.

sections.title: What happens if you break them
sections.body: The auto filter hides swear words with asterisks and gives a 15-minute mute for frequent swearing. Moderators can delete messages, warn, stop you from posting for a while (mute) or ban you from the community. Learning keeps working either way.

sections.title: Reports
sections.body: See something wrong? Press “Report” next to the message. After three reports a message is hidden until a moderator decides.

sections.title: What we store
sections.body: Your account email and name, settings, the words and rules you add or sync, and your learning progress: answers, streaks, XP, Coins, shop purchases, achievements and quests. If you connect Notion, a copy of the rows from the tables you choose and an encrypted Notion access token.

sections.title: Usage statistics
sections.body:
The app records a few events: opening it, viewing a section (just its name, no ids) and actions such as "word saved" or "Notion synced". Each event carries the platform (browser, installed app or desktop program), interface language, theme and the Apple-style switch.
When you are signed in, the event is linked to your account. For guests no identifier is stored at all. No IP addresses, no tracking cookies and no third-party analytics are used. Events are deleted automatically after 90 days.
You can turn statistics off at any time in Settings → Privacy.

sections.title: Why
sections.body: Only to run and improve the app: show your words, sync them with Notion, keep your progress on every device and understand which features help. We don't sell data or show ads.

sections.title: Who sees the data
sections.body: Only you see your words and rules. The owner and administrators of Lexicove see, in the admin panel, your email, name, sign-in method, sign-up date, last activity time, number of words, the names of linked Notion tables and sync errors, plus aggregated statistics. This is needed to run the service and help with problems. The content of your words is not shown in the admin panel.

sections.title: Community and notifications
sections.body:
Other users can see your name, username, avatar, level, the shop items you wear, your league and streak. Messages in chat rooms are visible to everyone signed in and kept for 180 days. Direct messages are seen only by the two of you; a moderator sees only what was reported. Friends can see when you were last online.
If you turn on reminders, your browser’s push subscription address is stored; it is deleted when you turn reminders off.

sections.title: Where
sections.body: Data is stored with Supabase (servers in the EU, Frankfurt). The website is served by Vercel. The Notion token is stored encrypted and is only available to a server function, never to the browser.

sections.title: Notion
sections.body: Lexicove only sees the pages you allowed when connecting. You can disconnect Notion at any time on the Words page, which deletes the token.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: You can export your words as CSV, disconnect Notion and ask for your account to be deleted with all its data.

sections.title: Open source
sections.body: All of Lexicove's code is public, so anyone can check exactly what happens to data.

sections.title: The service
sections.body: Lexicove is a free, open-source app for learning English. It is provided as is, without a guarantee of uninterrupted service.

sections.title: Your account
sections.body: You are responsible for keeping your account secure. One account per person; the community is open from age 13.

sections.title: Your content
sections.body: Your words, rules and other content stay yours. You allow Lexicove to store and process them only to run the app.

sections.title: Community rules
sections.body: No harassment, spam, scams or illegal content. Moderators may warn, temporarily restrict or ban an account.

sections.title: Coins
sections.body: Coins are an in-app reward for studying. They can't be bought, sold, exchanged for money or moved to another account. The server adds and spends them; in case of abuse (for example, automated answers) balances and purchases may be adjusted.

sections.title: Changes
sections.body: These terms may be updated; the date at the top shows the latest version.
